data.label: Billing FAQ
data.welcomeMessage:
Thank you for reaching out.

To change your plan, open Account → Subscription and select the plan you need.
If an invoice is missing, please check the email on your account and your spam folder.
If a payment failed, wait a few minutes and try again. If payment was taken but your plan or wallet did not update, keep your payment reference ready and we can connect you with an agent.

data.label: Templates FAQ
data.welcomeMessage:
Thank you for your message.

If a template is Pending, please wait for Meta review and avoid submitting the same template again.
If it was Rejected, update the category and wording, then submit again.
If messages are not delivering, confirm the WhatsApp number is Connected, use an approved template outside the 24-hour window, and check your wallet balance.
For campaigns, use an Approved template with a ready audience and sufficient wallet balance.

data.label: Account FAQ
data.welcomeMessage:
I can help with that.

If an OTP is missing, check spam, confirm the account email, then request a new code.
If WhatsApp is not connecting, open Account → Integration, try Chrome or Incognito, allow Meta popups, and use Meta admin access.
If the number is disconnected, reconnect it from Integration.
For team access issues, please ask your account admin to review role permissions.

data.label: Ask prompt
data.welcomeMessage: Please type your question in one short message, and we will assist you.

data.label: AI reply
data.customPrompt:
You are the WapApp customer help assistant on WhatsApp. Tone: warm-professional SaaS help desk. Polished business English.

Required reply shape every time:
1) One short acknowledge line (e.g. Thank you for reaching out. / I can help with that.)
2) Two to four short lines with clear steps in full sentences (paths like Account → Subscription)
3) One next-step line
Keep replies to 3–6 short lines. Answer only the user's issue.

Forbidden:
- Any URL or booking/Calendly/meeting link
- Support hours or Monday–Friday timings
- Mentions of buttons, menus, More options, Connect with us, or “in the app”
- Claiming you already requested or assigned an agent unless handoff already happened
- Selling or inventing pricing, refunds, or account changes
- Saying knowledge base, documents, or as an AI

If detail is missing: ask exactly one clarifying question, then stop.
If unsure, or for refunds/ownership/legal/login/payment-taken issues: offer an agent and say an agent typically replies within 15–30 minutes.
For campaign issues: ask what fails (not sending, pending, rejected template, wallet, audience) and give short WapApp steps.

data.label: Book a call
data.welcomeMessage:
Thank you. We would be glad to speak with you.

Please book a short call with our team using the link below:
https://calendly.com/tekpro-connect/25min

Choose a time that works for you, and we will guide the next steps.

data.label: After call link
data.bodyText: Is there anything else we can help you with?

data.label: Thanks
data.welcomeMessage:
Thank you. We are glad we could help.

Reply with help anytime if you need further assistance.
